# Telangana RTA Learner's Licence Practice (STALL Simulator)

> Authoritative, free, zero-login web simulator and complete 412-question study resource for the Telangana RTA Learner's Licence computerized STALL (Screen Test Aid for Learner Licence) examination conducted across Hyderabad and all Telangana District RTOs (TS/TG 01–38), plus Parivahan Sarathi learner licence preparation.

- Website: https://llr.sarvacapital.in/
- Hosted by: Sarva Capital (https://sarvacapital.in)
- Access: 100% Free, No Login Required, Mobile-Friendly
- Active Simulator Language: English (official RTA exam text preserved; Telugu & Hindi are temporarily paused while translations are audited)
- Master Question Bank: 412 official Telangana Transport Department questions (94 Road Signs, 159 Rules of the Road, 159 General Driving Principles)

## Key Examination Facts (Telangana STALL)
- **Exam Name**: STALL (Screen Test Aid for Learner Licence) computerized examination (plus contactless Aadhaar e-KYC online LLR test via Parivahan Sarathi).
- **Governing Body**: Transport Department, Government of Telangana (Telangana RTA) under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 & Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989.
- **Total Questions per Exam**: 20 questions sampled across 3 mandatory quotas: 8 Road Signs (40%), 8 Rules of the Road (40%), 4 General Driving Principles (20%).
- **Time Limit**: 30 seconds per question (10 minutes maximum).
- **Passing Mark**: 12 correct out of 20 (60%); zero negative marking.
- **Early Termination**: Terminal immediately finishes as PASSED at 12 correct answers, or FAILED at 9 wrong answers.
- **Shuffled Option Order**: Answer options (1, 2, 3, 4) are shuffled per question by default to match the latest STALL exam format and prevent memorizing option positions.

## Pages & Study Guides
- [STALL Mock Exam Simulator](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/): Interactive 20-question exam simulator with 30s timer, 95% readiness gate, tutor mode, and QR cross-device sync.
- [All 94 Telangana Road Signs & Meanings](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/road-signs/): Visual directory of Mandatory, Cautionary, and Informatory road signs.
- [Complete 412 LLR Question Bank & Answers](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/question-bank/): Full static reference of all 412 official questions, options, verified answers, and explanations.
- [Road Signs Question Bank (94 Q&As)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/question-bank/road-signs/): Focused 94-question Road Signs & Signals practice bank.
- [Traffic Rules Question Bank (159 Q&As)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/question-bank/traffic-rules/): Focused 159-question Rules of the Road Regulations bank.
- [Driving Principles Question Bank (159 Q&As)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/question-bank/driving-principles/): Focused 159-question General Driving Principles & Safety bank.
- [Online LLR Test & Sarathi Contactless Guide](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/online-llr-test/): Aadhaar e-KYC contactless online LLR test process on Parivahan Sarathi, webcam/liveness rules, and curriculum coverage.
- [Hyderabad & Telangana RTO Guide](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/rto-guide/): Required documents checklist (Form 2, Aadhaar, Form 1/1A), 5-step test-day process, fees (₹200 single / ₹350 dual / ₹150 retest), and RTO center addresses (TS/TG-07 to TS/TG-12).
- [Permanent DL Track Test & Slot Booking Guide](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/dl-test-guide/): Two-Wheeler Figure '8' Track and Car 'H' Track rules, automated RFID tracks, online slot booking, tgtransport.online/llr/ safety training, and digital LLR download via DigiLocker / mParivahan.
- [Telangana Traffic Fines & Hand Signals](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/traffic-fines/): Statutory MV Act traffic fines (helmet, drunk driving, overspeeding, no licence) plus visual driver & traffic police hand signals.
- [All Telangana District RTO Codes (TS/TG 01–38)](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/telangana-rto-codes/): Complete list of all 38 Telangana district RTA codes (Adilabad to Narayanpet, covering both TS and TG prefixes).
- [Rapid Cheatsheet, Hand Signals & Tricky Twins](https://llr.sarvacapital.in/cheatsheet/): Printable 10-minute revision rules, hand signals, and side-by-side comparisons of commonly confused road signs.
